title: Pacific Drive
shortDescription: First-person driving survival through the surreal Olympic Exclusion Zone, maintaining your station wagon as your sole lifeline.
historicalSignificance: Praised for tactile mechanical vehicle interactions, atmospheric Pacific Northwest dread, and emergent survival loops.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
